items.q: Why treat sexual problems as a medical opportunity?
items.a: **Bad sex often signals overall health breaking down.** Investigate ED like chest pain — clitoral/penile blood flow mirrors vascular health; sexual dysfunction can precede heart disease.

items.q: How strong is the ED → heart disease link?
items.a: **52%** of men 50+ have ED (+**10%/decade**). Organic ED → heart issues within **3–5 years**; **14%** heart attack by **7 years**. Morning erections (3–5/night when young) are a health marker.

**Fuel** (Mediterranean/anti-inflammatory; 100g pistachios/day reduced ED in a study), **strength** (**150 min/week cardio ≈ Viagra-level** improvement + pelvic floor), **environment** (stress, sleep, EDCs, porn norms), **confidence** (anatomy knowledge, novelty, toys OK).

items.q: How fast can sleep wreck testosterone?
items.a: **5 h vs 8 h** sleep ≈ **15% testosterone drop in one week**. Fixing sleep apnea can raise T ~**200 ng/dL**. Erection also needs **parasympathetic** rest-and-digest — chronic stress is sympathetic lockout.

items.q: What do most women need for orgasm?
items.a: The clitoris is the **homologue of the penis** (full internal structure). ~**85%** need clitoral stimulation; penetration alone usually won't get them there. Woman-on-top and CAT raise orgasm rates.

items.q: When and how should couples talk about sex?
items.a: **Not in the bedroom** — use a parallel walk/car, start positive, share a podcast/video as bridge. Men often use sex as intimacy language; stressed women may experience it as **added load**.

items.q: How much has average male testosterone fallen?
items.a: Average T dropped ~**600 ng/dL (1990s) → 450 (2015)** — obesity/aromatase, insulin resistance, ultraprocessed food, endocrine disruptors.

items.q: What's the difference between TRT and steroid abuse?
items.a: TRT restores **normal** levels; bodybuilding doses show ~**15× heart failure** and **122× cardiac death**. ~**70% infertile** after ~**18 mo** TRT; chase **symptoms not numbers** — receptors saturate.

**Amount matters less than guilt/compulsion.** Couples watching together often report higher satisfaction; daily masturbation + long refractory can create **partner arousal mismatch**. Novelty can be a different pillow — not necessarily BDSM.

items.q: Why is sex declining among young adults?
items.a: Phones/social media (**8–10 hr/day** outliers), hookup culture + bad first experiences, porn-curated expectations, and rising **rough sex/choking** (**60%** of college women choked; most don't enjoy it).

items.q: Does sexual frequency relate to longevity?
items.a: Sex ~**once/week** → **49% longer life** association; **100 orgasms** → **13%** longevity bump (men). Gottman micro-intimacy: **20-sec hug**, **6-sec kiss** reduce stress.
